heading: Ngā ratonga ka taea e tēnei pae te whakamahi
stateAsk: Kāore anō kia kōwhiria: ka pātai i te tuatahi
changedDeny: Kua tiakina: kāore a {service} i whakaaetia.
withdrawn: Kua unuhia ngā kōwhiringa katoa. Ka pātai anō ia ratonga.
serviceSends_google_analytics: Ka tatau i ngā toronga me ngā whārangi kua pānuihia. Ka whiwhi a Google i tō wāhitau IP, ā, tērā pea ka tautuhi pihikete.
serviceSends_youtube: Ka purei ataata mai i YouTube. Ka whiwhi a Google i tō wāhitau IP, ā, tērā pea ka tautuhi pihikete.
serviceSends_vimeo: Ka purei ataata mai i Vimeo. Ka whiwhi a Vimeo i tō wāhitau IP; ka tono tēnei pae kia kaua koe e aroturukitia.
serviceSends_google_maps: Ka whakaatu mahere mai i Google Maps. Ka whiwhi a Google i tō wāhitau IP, ā, tērā pea ka tautuhi pihikete.
serviceSends_speech: Ki te kore e taea e tō pūtirotiro te mōhio ki te reo kōrero i tō pūrere, ka haere tō reo ki tāna ratonga reo (Google, Apple, Microsoft rānei).
serviceSends_github: Ka whakaatu kāri pūranga me ētahi atu ihirangi mai i GitHub. Ka whiwhi a GitHub i tō wāhitau IP, ā, tērā pea ka tautuhi pihikete.
serviceSends_webstatus: Ka whakaatu tohu tautoko pūtirotiro Baseline mai i webstatus.dev, he kaupapa Google Chrome. Ka whiwhi a Google i tō wāhitau IP.
serviceSends_aframe: Ka uta i te pātaka A-Frame mai i aframe.io hei whakaatu whakaaturanga 3D. Ka whiwhi a aframe.io i tō wāhitau IP.
serviceSends_embed: Ka whakaatu ihirangi mai i {host}. Ka whiwhi a {host} i tō wāhitau IP, ā, tērā pea ka tautuhi pihikete.
